about: VideoPlayer — a video shown as its poster until the viewer presses play. Nothing from a third party loads before that press: no player script, no iframe, no cookie, no request to YouTube or Vimeo. A p

title.about: What the video is. Names the play button ("Play: <title>"), the embedded player and the transcript link.

poster.about: The picture shown until play is pressed. Default: the kit's Plate, labelled with `posterLabel`.

posterLabel.about: The words on the default plate ("Video", "Product tour"). Ignored when `poster` is given.

ratio.about: Width / height, as CSS reads it. The poster and the player share it, so nothing shifts on play.

duration.about: How long it runs, as it should read on the poster: "4:05", "52:14", "1:02:30".

src.about: A self-hosted file. After play, a native <video> with controls plays it. Wins over `embed`.

embed.about: A video on YouTube or Vimeo. After play, that service's player in an iframe. Nothing loads before.

captions.about: The video has captions: marks the poster "CC" (said as "Captions available").

transcriptHref.about: Where its transcript is. Adds a "Transcript" link under the player.
